text.description_html:
AHI SIG719-630 Contemporary Stainless Flush Ring Pull

This is a Contemporary design flush mount ring pull. Stainless steel flush ring pulls are resistant to corrosion, knocks, scratches and abrasion making it an ideal material for door hardware. It's for use on swinging doors, pocket doors, sliding doors, cabinet doors. Any door where a "Flush with the door face" pull is desired.

Specifications: for AHI SIG719-630 Stainless Flush Ring Pull

  • Total Height: 2-3/4" (70 MM)
  • Total Width: 2-3/4" (70 MM)
  • Total Depth: 1/2" (11 MM)
  • Door Cutout Depth: 5/16"
  • Projection: 3/16"
  • Door Cutout Diameter: 2-1/4"
  • 3/16" Thick Solid Stainless Steel
  • Packaged with matching satin stainless mounting screws
  • AHI SIG719 Dimensions (PDF)

Note: If the square flush pull face is NOT mortised into the door, it will have a 3/16" projection off the doors face. Available in Satin Stainless Steel finish only.

Sold Individually



** This is discontinued. Use AHI 722 Ring Pull
